title: Inferring protein from transcript abundances using convolutional neural networks
summary: Specific biological sequence-feature and protein-abundance result goes beyond a generic benchmark: learned CNN features identify interpretable motifs in two organisms. Cross-validation and limited predictive power are stated; motif causal effects remain hypotheses. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.ai_role: CNN trained/evaluated over human and Arabidopsis datasets using mRNA/protein sequence and abundance; repeated cross-validation. Predictive R² 0.30 (human), 0.32 (Arabidopsis); learned sequence motifs recover known regulatory signals, including translation initiation and UTR motifs. Local sequence-only predictions explain limited variance and do not establish causality.
